Why 'you can have anything' leaves out two key words.

Kevin Trudeau goes back to Napoleon Hill's famous line about what the mind can conceive and believe. He says the original ended with "within reason," and that part got edited out of the popular version.

He also separates a wish from belief. In his words, belief means total certainty, aimed at a target you can actually see.

What target could you see clearly if you looked?

Why you can't overcome something you caused.

Kevin Trudeau says people ask how he overcame prison, and he corrects them. He didn't overcome it, because he caused it. He got through it.

The biggest quality he took from that time was accountability. He used to blame everything on something else. Now he looks in the mirror and speaks out loud, because it is very hard to go back to making excuses once you hear yourself say it.

What excuse have you been telling yourself?
